answer:
Estimate the thermal-mismatch strain in an aluminum film bonded to a ceramic substrate.
Use the film coefficient of thermal expansion α_f = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use the substrate coefficient of thermal expansion α_s = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
The system is cooled by ΔT = 180 K.
Compute the mismatch strain as ε = Δα × ΔT where Δα = α_f − α_s = 15×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
The resulting mismatch strain is ε = 15×10⁻⁶ × 180 = 2.7×10⁻³ (approximately 0.27%, or 2700 microstrain).
State that the strain is tensile in the aluminum film upon cooling, since the film has the higher CTE.
Report the answer as a magnitude of approximately 2.7×10⁻³.
